name: The Rangers
description: The specialist outer-range branch of the Greenshields. Rangers are sworn Greenshields who have completed additional specialist training and serve in the order's most distributed and most independent posts: continuous threshold-watch at the realm-to-realm Border, outer-range reconnaissance through the Feywood's edges where the liminal geometry is most active, military-coded escort of sanctioned visitors when civilian Hall of Guides escort is insufficient, and operational contact with realm-side forces when the Council authorizes it. The Ranger branch maintains approximately one hundred fifty active members within the Greenshields' total of six hundred. Rangers are not a separate order; they are Greenshields who do specialist work, under the Captain of the Ranger Branch who reports to the Greenshield Commander.
